Hi Product Hunt! I'm Sergio, the maker of Loqui.

A while ago I came across apps that turn speech into polished text and loved the idea. I thought I could build one in that spirit, with the features I'd actually want. A few friends joined in to test every build, and after months of work (and a fair amount of fear of hitting publish), here it is.

Dictate in any app: hold a shortcut, speak, and clean text lands at your cursor

Tones: the same sentence comes out casual for a chat or polished for an email

Meetings: transcription, who said what, and ready-made minutes

Your audio is discarded right after transcription, and your history stays on your Mac

There's a free plan with a weekly quota, no card required. For the Product Hunt community, code PRODUCTHUNT gives 50% off Pro for 3 months.

I'd love to hear where you type the most, and what would make you talk instead.

Weboldal: https://loquime.com
